subject: Urgent: PO#4227 — salvage plan for backordered promo kits (EU fulfillment)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@meridian-fulfillment.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: PO#4227 — salvage plan for backordered promo kits (EU fulfillment)

Sophie —

Thanks for flagging the production issue on zip pulls. PO#4227 is time-sensitive: we have three regional events starting 05/12 (Berlin, Amsterdam, Madrid) and we need at least 2,500 completed kits on-site across the three venues. The current update that the main zipper supplier is delayed puts the entire shipment at risk.

Can Meridian propose a salvage plan that meets these constraints? Specifically:
- Split fulfillment: ship completed components to a local EU kitting partner if factory can't finish full kits in time
- Alternate component: can you confirm an equivalent zipper/substitute we can accept (material/color swatch required)
- Customs & paperwork: provide EORI-compatible invoices and CN22/CN23 guidance so we don't hit holds at EU ports
- Partial shipments: earliest ready date for a partial run (minimum 800 kits) and expected transit times

I've attached the original PO and last approved artwork for quick reference. Please treat this as high priority — Marissa and Laura are copied for logistics and on-site distribution planning.

Markus Klein
Head of Events
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_4227.pdf (purchase order), art-final-v2.ai (artwork source)
From: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@meridian-fulfillment.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 13:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Urgent: PO#4227 — salvage plan for backordered promo kits (EU fulfillment)

Markus / Marissa / Laura —

Apologies for the late notice and the production disruption. Quick summary of what happened: our primary zipper supplier experienced a tooling failure that impacts runs scheduled between 04/29–05/05. We understand the event constraints and have put together a three-part salvage proposal:

1) Immediate partial shipment (Factory -> Rotterdam hub): we can ship 900 fully completed kits that used existing zipper inventory by 05/06 (ETA Rotterdam 05/09).

2) Alternate component + local kitting: for the remaining quantity, we propose an identical-profile coil zipper (same color, slightly different pull tab). We will route remaining components to our EU kitting partner (GreenBox Freight) for assembly; that will enable a second tranche of ~1,600 kits shipped from Rotterdam by 05/11 (ETA per venue 05/12–05/13 depending on city).

3) Paperwork & duty: attached are the updated invoice (invoice-4227-updated.pdf) and a provisional commercial invoice formatted with EORI fields. We will mark shipments as "partial shipment" and provide HS codes to speed customs clearance.

We are attaching a refreshed design proof (promo-kit-proof-v3.pdf) — the only visible change is the pull tab shape (we've called out a red squared highlight on the item). Please confirm acceptance of the alternate zipper by EOD 05/02 so we can lock the kitting schedule.

As a gesture for the disruption, Meridian will credit expedited last-mile freight for both tranches (we will book GreenBox for on-the-ground deliveries).

Next steps we recommend:
- Approval of alternate zipper (accept/reject)
- Confirmation on whether Redwood will accept split shipments to multiple venue addresses or prefer a single hub drop for your team to distribute

Best,

Sophie Laurent
Account Manager
Meridian Fulfillment Co.

Attachments: promo-kit-proof-v3.pdf, invoice-4227-updated.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@meridian-fulfillment.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: PO#4227 — salvage plan for backordered promo kits (EU fulfillment)

Sophie —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the credit offer. A few clarifications from events ops:
- Can you send a close-up photo of the alternate pull tab next to the current one and a physical color swatch code (Pantone or RAL)? Visual match is important for brand consistency.
- For the two tranches, Redwood prefers that the first 900 kits go directly to the Berlin venue (address in Drive link) and the second tranche be split between Amsterdam (800) and Madrid (800). If customs prevents direct venue delivery, route both tranches to our Berlin hub and we will redistribute locally.
- Please confirm whether GreenBox will handle final-mile white-glove (on-site drop + inventory check) or only curbside delivery.
- Regarding the credit: is Meridian covering the uplift for express sea-to-air or just trucking within EU? We need a simple line item in the updated invoice showing the credit value.

If you can get the photo/swatch and the updated invoice by EOD 05/02, we'll approve the alternate pull and sign off on the split routing.

Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@meridian-fulfillment.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, GreenBox Freight <ops@greenboxfreight.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:37:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Urgent: PO#4227 — salvage plan for backordered promo kits (EU fulfillment)

Marissa / team —

Thanks — sending what you requested:
- Attached: close-up photo of alternate pull tab and Pantone reference (swatch-photo.jpg in the Drive link). Color is an exact PANTONE 186 C match.
- GreenBox has confirmed white-glove service for venue deliveries (they will do on-site check and sign-off). I've looped them here.
- Credit & invoice: We updated invoice-4227-updated.pdf and included a line item showing a €1,250 expedited shipping credit. Meridian will cover express air uplift for any portion that cannot meet the event window; otherwise credit applies to EU trucking fees.
- Provisional logistics: partial tranche 1 (900 kits) scanned and outbound 05/06 from factory — provisional tracking (Rotterdam hub): RDF-RTM-0001123. Tranche 2 components to arrive Rotterdam 05/07 for kitting; GreenBox estimates completed kits and outbound to venues 05/11.

We will upload the customs-ready pack (commercial invoice, packing list, HS codes) to the Drive folder and share DocuSign for the customs declaration release (DocuSign link above).

Sophie Laurent
Account Manager
Meridian Fulfillment Co.

Attachments: (see Drive) swatch-photo.jpg, customs-pack.zip (drive link)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@meridian-fulfillment.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, GreenBox Freight <ops@greenboxfreight.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: PO#4227 — salvage plan for backordered promo kits (EU fulfillment)

Sophie / GreenBox / Marissa / Laura —

Appreciate the rapid recovery plan and the credit. We accept the alternate zipper (Pantone 186 C match confirmed visually acceptable). Approve the split routing: 900 -> Berlin (direct if customs allows), remainder split 800 Amsterdam / 800 Madrid per Marissa's notes.

Two requests before we close this out:
1) Please confirm final pickup dates and provide confirmed tracking numbers for tranche 1 before EOD 05/06 so our CS reps can track reception at the Berlin venue.
2) Push the DocuSign customs release to Markus (me) for immediate sign-off — I will countersign as soon as it's in my inbox.

Laura will coordinate local distribution at the venues. Thanks again to Meridian and GreenBox for the flexibility here.

Markus Klein
Head of Events
Redwood Inference
